New voice sessions will now write to `<home>ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<id>/session.jsonl` (home "/" gives `public/ai/sessions/2026/10/19/v-xxx/session.jsonl`). It is committed on branch `worktree/qf-7` as `ffc3a6e43`, touching 3 files (12 insertions, 5 deletions). `layers.test.mjs` passes, 55 checks, but it doesn't exercise the new path. I haven't merged or restarted Servex.

- **One helper:** the path shape lives in `Sessions.session_path(home, id, date)` in `Servex/agents/Sessions.js`, so changing it later is one line. A card home works the same way. I checked it only by reading the code, not by creating a session.
- **Summary file:** the summary needed no code change. It is derived from the session file's name, so it lands as `session.summary.json` beside `session.jsonl`.
- **Old sessions:** they keep the `file` stored in `sessions.json` (flat `<home>ai/<id>.jsonl`). The readers I found use that stored value, so both shapes work. I did not check Server/ or the sessions grid code, which had no old-path matches in my grep.
- **Docs:** I updated the path lines in the `ext/Session` readme, the comments in `Sessions.js`, and one tool description in `tools.js`. I did not touch `ux/Dictate/readme.md` or any `Servex/doc/` page, because my grep found no old-path line in either.
- **Not done:**
  - Deliverable 3, the link from the site to the new folders: only the `ext/Session` readme mentions them, and no day page or `ux/Dictate` link was added.
  - Deliverable 5, the optional `git mv` script for the old flat files.
- **Decision logged:** the home-relative path (your amendment) is recorded in `task.jsonl`, with the global `/framework/ai/sessions/` path named as the alternative.

All five steps are committed on `worktree/qf-7`. I did not merge or restart Servex.

- **Central path:** `Sessions.session_path` now defaults to `/framework/ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<id>/session.jsonl`, and `home` is only a field. The per-directory shape is a commented alternative line in the same helper. Commit `2d9970b97`.
- **`kind: "voice"`:** it is on line 1 of the session file and in the `sessions.json` entry. The grid already had a `kind` index, so I added `voice` as its first rule in `AISessionBuckets.KINDS` rather than a second field. I didn't look at the grid screenshot, so I haven't confirmed it shows or filters by voice. Same commit.
- **Real test:**
  - **Script:** `real-test.mjs` is beside the brief and builds a real `Sessions` in a temp repo with prewarm off.
  - **Output:** it printed `PASS /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/19/v-bituoem/session.jsonl`, `summary: session.summary.json`, and line 1 `{"session":{"id":"v-bituoem","home":"/","kind":"voice",...}}`.
  - **Asserts:** the file is at the dated path, `kind` is voice in line 1 and in `sessions.json`, and `summary_file` and `tail` work.
  - **`layers.test.mjs`:** 55 checks pass.
  - **Loader hook:** the worktree has no `node_modules`, and linking one is forbidden. So I wrote `hook.mjs` and `resolver.mjs` beside the test, and they fall back to the main tree's `Servex/node_modules`. Run it as `node --import ./hook.mjs real-test.mjs`.
- **Site check:** `/framework/ai/sessions/` loads on `http://127.0.0.1:64421` (the worktree's port) with about 930 rows and no JavaScript exceptions. The only failures are 404s for generated data files that don't exist in the worktree: `directory.json`, `tasks.json`, `page-work.json` and `weight.jsonl`. I didn't compare against the main tree to confirm those 404s also appear there.
- **Readmes:** the `ux/Dictate` and `ext/Session` readmes now say where voice sessions live. A voice session folder holds only `session.jsonl`, with no `task.jsonl` and no `page.js`. I didn't add a day-page listing.
- **Move script:** `Servex/agents/move-voice-sessions.mjs` is committed as `35c1e64de` and only the dry run was executed. It skips `v-timqv56`. `--apply` runs `git mv` and rewrites each stored `file`, and `--undo <manifest>` reverses it. Both refuse while Servex is up, which they detect by whether port 80 accepts a connection. The dry run listed 36 files, for example:
  - `public/framework/ext/drawer/ai/v-519tckm.jsonl` → `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/17/v-519tckm/session.jsonl`
  - `public/framework/ext/Chat/ai/v-w462yca.summary.json` → `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/09/v-w462yca/session.summary.json`

  I haven't run `--apply` or `--undo`.

The decision is logged in `task.jsonl`.

I wrote the design and counts, and built nothing.

- **Today:** the per-day `index.json` is written by code (`AISessionIndex`, live; `freeze()` closes finished days). Month and year totals hold only counts and dollars. Nothing records what landed per day or per month, and nothing happens at midnight. The older whole-repo dumps and the tag script are manual or stale.
- **Counts (30 days):** `kind`, `module` and `tags` are 0% of the 1,077 task files. `parent_task` is 37% and `home` is under 1%. Session tags are 19% and `parent` is 16%. 605 of 1,077 tasks have a landed time.
- **Recommendation:** append one landed line per task to a day file and a month file such as `2026-10.jsonl`, written by `Servex/Landed.js` and `freeze()`. At midnight, leave sessions where they started and add a pointer line in the next day's folder.

The design file is `index-design/design.md`, beside `count.mjs` and `counts.txt`. Two caveats: I did not write the `ReportFindings` verdict, since this was a design check rather than a page review. The old voice-session `log.jsonl` files are dead since 2026-10-17, so they are not session indexes.

The walkthrough is written at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/19/session-3db83139/task-mastermind-voice-opus/walkthrough/walkthrough.md`. I changed no code and haven't committed the file.

It follows one sentence, "All right, create an opus mastermind.", through lines 30–36 of `public/ai/v-timqv56.jsonl`. The `{chat}`, `{quiet}`, `{place}` and smart-reply lines are real, printed from the file by node. Each step has a `file:line` link, a snippet of three lines or fewer, and a 6-line ASCII diagram sits at the top.

- **No saved Whisper reply:** I didn't find a copy of the exact Whisper reply for this sentence, so step 1 shows the reply's shape, not a copied line. The note says so.
- **Different sentence for `{refined}`:** the `{refined}` example is from line 24 of the same file, about a different sentence. Nothing was refined for this one.
- **Line numbers:** I read them off the code but did not recheck them after writing. The ✓/? mark method is at `Widget.js:192`, not the 196 your brief gave.

Deliverables 1–10 are built and committed in qf-6 (`73f58d561`, `577d3356d`). I didn't merge or restart anything. The mic meter is only checked with a forced `--level`, because headless Chrome can't open the mic.

Shots are in `C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-6/shots-sheet/`, untracked. "Before" is michael/dev at `monorepo.localhost`; "after" is qf-6.
- **Before:** `before-400-h380.png`, `before-400-h640.png`, `before-1200.png`
- **After:** `after-400-h380.png`, `after-400-h640.png`, `after-1200.png`
- **Extras:** `menu-split-400.png` (menu open), `tab-full-400.png` (Dictation tab), `meter-60.png` (meter at 60%)

1. **Mic meter:** the mic button is a dark translucent disc with a `--prime` fill rising to `--level`. `DictationBar` wraps the mic's existing `on_meter` once, and one animation frame writes `--level`. The pulse is gone while listening.
2. **Listening row:** hidden inside the sheet only (the non-compact `MicIndicator` and `.ux-dictate-level`). I didn't find a separate listening row in the shots, so that hide is a guess.
3. **One bottom row:** `[mic] [word · hint] [⌨]`, with Type as an icon-only button. The composer is a small footer pinned under the chat, and the thread flexes to fill the sheet.
4. **Tabs to the top:** "AI ▾" is a dropdown listing AI (chat), Dictation and Settings, with New session right after it and ✕ at the far right. The bottom tab row and "More" are removed.
5. **Reachable at every height:** the menu works at half and full height. At strip height I added a small ▾ in the strip row that opens the sheet to half and shows the menu. I tried the ▾ from the strip and then picked Dictation. I didn't check the menu at the strip itself.
6. **Shots:** 400 at two heights (380, 640) plus 1200. The 1200 page has no sheet, because the sheet only exists below 52em, so that shot only shows the page.
7. **Full width:** the sheet has no side padding, and the chat card and composer lose their side borders, shadow and rounded corners.
8. **Padding and footer:**
   - Bubble text width wasn't measured with a script. From the shots, the bubble goes from about 300px to about 310px wide, so the text gains roughly 10px.
   - The thread keeps its 0.6em inset and bubble padding is cut to 0.5em.
9. **Scroll bars:** only the chat scrolls, except the Dictation and Settings tab bodies, which scroll on their own because they have nothing else to scroll with.
10. **Header and padding:** the sheet owns no padding. Only the title bar has its own, and the grip sits in the title bar's top inset.

- **Tab URL:** picking a tab does not write it into the URL; it worked that way before and I kept it. This is the one thing in deliverable 4 I left out. Say if you want it routed.
- **Console errors:** the only one is "this browser can't run the audio pipeline", which appears on michael/dev too. Some 404s (`directory.json`, `tasks.json`, `weight.jsonl`) also come from the page, not these changes.
- **Files:** the tab logic is in `ext/drawer/Sheet.js`, not `rail.js`, because `rail.js` is a 6-line shim. I changed `Sheet.js`, `rail.css`, `DictationBar.js` and `DictationBar.css`.
- **Out-of-date docs:** `ux/Dictate/doc/refine-dictate-tasks.md#the-bar` and the `DictationBar` class comment still describe the old Type button and caption row.

I've finished the whole brief and I'm not doing anything now. It's committed in qf-6 as `73f58d561` and `577d3356d`, and I haven't merged or restarted anything.

All ten deliverables are built: the mic as the level meter, one compact footer row, the "AI ▾" menu at every sheet height, a full-width chat and no sheet padding. The mic meter is only checked with a forced `--level`, because headless Chrome can't open the mic.

Before and after shots at 400 (two sheet heights) and 1200 are in `C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-6/shots-sheet/`. The 1200 shots only show the page, because the sheet doesn't exist at that width.

The only console error is the "this browser can't run the audio pipeline" message, which michael/dev shows too.

I did not write the open tab into the URL. It worked that way before and I kept it.
